━━━ Village home · a group with no village: the call to found one ━━━
(edits message 42)
🏡 This group has no village yet.

A village is your group's home: it has a shared treasury, buildings and knowledge, and everyone who lives there shares in it. Open the founding form with the button below; nothing is built until it is complete.
  ───
  [🏗 Found the village] → settlement:found
  [🔙 Back] → player:profile.get

━━━ Residence · asks before joining ━━━
(edits message 42)
🏡 Become a resident of Korendal?

Your home moves to this village. Your properties, companies and job stay where they are, but from now on your income tax goes to the village treasury and you need a work permit to work in other cities.
You cannot move home again for 72h.
  ───
  [✅ Yes, I will live here] → settlement:join:confirm
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:overview
